## Appearance

Ruby is a handsome young lady with a plump, showy figure and showy looks. She has large, bright-blue eyes, a brilliant complexion, and golden hair that she has worn in a long yellow braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful, good-tempered, and merry individual who is known for laughing a great deal. However, she is also inclined to be hysterical when frightened, such as when she faces a mortal dread of green caterpillars. She is highly coquettish and deeply obsessed with young men, constantly conscious of boys and focused on receiving compliments from them. From a young age, her ambitions centered on having numerous suitors and enjoying a very gay time before settling down. Her long-term plan is to study to become a teacher, teach for only two years, and then get married.

## History

Ruby Gillis grew up in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) with several older sisters who were married or courted, and she once charmed away her warts using a magic pebble from old [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md). She attended school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and joined her and other classmates in forming a story club. While attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), she visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with their friends to anxiously discuss their upcoming final examinations and commencement plans. Ruby later earned a teaching license and was hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) school, and she also took a autumn trip to visit [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston). In a later summer, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visited Ruby at her home, where Ruby displayed summer clothes and aggressively denied her terminal illness. Soon after, Ruby spent an evening with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), tearfully confessing her fear of death and her unfulfilled dreams, before passing away peacefully in her sleep the next night.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. ## Quotes

> “Nor I,” said Ruby Gillis, with a shiver. “I don’t mind floating down when there’s two or three of us in the flat and we can sit up. It’s fun then. But to lie down and pretend I was dead—I just couldn’t. I’d die really of fright.”
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)

> "There’s a concert at Carmody and a party at White Sands. Herb Spencer’s going to take me. He’s my latest. Be sure to come up tomorrow. I’m dying for a good talk with you. I want to hear all about your doings at Redmond."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Life P8](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0008)

> "Me! Why, I’m perfectly well. I never felt better in my life. Of course, that congestion last winter pulled me down a little. But just see my color. I don’t look much like an invalid, I’m sure."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Life P57](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0057)

> "Anne, it won’t be long now before I’ll be lying over there. You and Diana and all the rest will be going about, full of life—and I’ll be there—in the old graveyard—dead!"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Summons P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007)

> "I’ll try. I’ll think over what you have said, and try to believe it. And you’ll come up as often as you can, won’t you, Anne?"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Summons P21](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0021)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby is a long-standing friend and childhood playmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their shared school years are filled with social activities, such as attending parties, preparing for a school [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert under Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), and visiting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while she recovers from an injury.
